sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using Houndjo, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Use of Services
sections.body: You agree to use our services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You must not use our services to:
list: Violate any applicable laws or regulations
Infringe on the rights of others
Transmit harmful, offensive, or disruptive content
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems

sections.heading: 3. Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Houndjo and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by Houndjo and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

sections.heading: 5. Termination
sections.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at our sole discretion, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms or is harmful to other users, us, or third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Houndjo shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of or inability to use our services.

sections.heading: 7. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at:

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, use our services, or contact us for support. This includes:
list: Usage data and activity logs within our platform

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to operate, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send transactional and promotional communications, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 3. Information Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our platform, subject to confidentiality agreements.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: 5. Security
sections.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.heading: 6. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us recognize your browser, remember your preferences, and improve your experience on our platform.

sections.heading: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
sections.body: We use the following categories of cookies:
list: Strictly necessary cookies — Required for the platform to function. These include session and authentication cookies.
Preference cookies — Store your settings such as language, theme, and display preferences.
Analytics cookies — Help us understand how visitors interact with our platform so we can improve it.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences across sessions, analyze usage patterns to improve our services, and ensure the security and integrity of your account.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Some cookies may be set by third-party services that appear on our pages. We do not control these cookies and recommend reviewing the privacy policies of those third parties.

sections.heading: 5. Managing Cookies
sections.body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our platform. Refer to your browser's help documentation for instructions on managing cookies.

sections.heading: 6. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at:
